strikes-ban.label: Number of strike for a ban (separated by ;)
strikes-ban.helpText: How many strikes for auto-ban to triggers, if multiple values are provided, the second ban will use the second value and so on.

ban-duration.label: Number of day for ban duration (0 = permanent, separated by ;)
ban-duration.helpText: How long the ban lasts, if multiple values are provided, the second ban will use the second value and so on.

span-days.label: How many days will be considered?
span-days.helpText: Strikes automatically expire after 365 days, but you can set a shorter period (0 = max).

no-ban.label: Don't ban, just notify
no-ban.helpText: If checked, the app will only notify the mod team via ModMail.

ignore-approved.label: Don't ban Approved users
ignore-approved.helpText: If checked, Approved users are skipped, the app will only notify the mod team via ModMail.

ban-text.label: Ban message
ban-text.defaultValue:
You have been banned because of too many content removed by our team:

{list}
